chunks.heading: 1. Start the server
chunks.text:
1. Start the server

The server runs one model at a time on port 11434. It listens
only on the loopback address, so other machines cannot reach
it.

chunks.heading: Before you start
chunks.text:
Before you start

Check that the model file is
present and that its digest
matches the value in the
release record. A different
digest means a different
build.

Free at least 6 GB of memory
before loading the vision
model.

chunks.heading: Start command
chunks.text:
Start command

Run the start script from
the service account, not
from a personal shell. The
script writes its process ID
to run/server.pid.

Wait for the line ready on
11434 in the log before
sending requests.

If the log shows address already in use, another server is
still running. Stop it with the stop script; do not delete
the PID file by hand.

chunks.heading: 2. Health checks

2. Health checks

Run these checks after every restart. Each one must pass
before the server takes traffic again.

Check  Command  Pass when
Version  GET /api/version  returns 0.32.14
Models  GET /api/tags  lists gemma4:e2b
Digest  compare digest  matches record
Smoke  one short chat  answer not empty

chunks.heading: When a check fails

When a check fails

Stop at the first failed check. Record its name, the time and
the full error text in the incident log then roll back to
the previous release.

chunks.heading: Keep two releases
chunks.text:
Keep two releases

Each release directory holds
the model digest, the server
version and the prompt
files. Keep the current and
the previous release on
disk.

chunks.heading: Switch back
chunks.text:
Switch back

Point the current link at
the previous release,
restart the server and run
every health check again.

Do not edit files inside a
release directory.

A rollback is complete only when all four restart checks pass
on the previous release. Write the release ID and the time in
the incident log.
